subject: Draft MAP & next steps — Novamed pilot timeline options

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & next steps — Novamed pilot timeline options

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the call today. Good to learn more about Novamed's immediate objectives for the pilot (patient triage + discharge summary generation). Per our discussion, I attached an initial draft of a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to get alignment on milestones, owners, and target close windows.

Key milestones (high level):
- Pilot kickoff: environment & data access (owner: Novamed IT) — target week of Apr 12
- Integration & ingest: S3 connector + schema mapping (owner: Novamed Eng / Redwood Integrations) — 2 weeks after kickoff
- Model eval & quality sweep: baseline prompts and holdouts (owner: Novamed Clinical + Redwood ML) — 2 weeks after integration
- Security & procurement signoff: SOC2 questionnaire + PO (owner: Novamed Security / Procurement) — concurrent with eval
- Pilot go/no-go & close (owner: Novamed PM + Redwood CSM) — target window options below

Target close window (choose one):
- Option A: 2026-05-28 (aggressive)
- Option B: 2026-06-30 (recommended)
- Option C: 2026-07-31 (conservative; allows extra procurement time)

Dependencies & open items we flagged on the call:
- Access to sample de-identified records (Novamed legal/privacy)
- SOC 2 questionnaire completion and evidence for hosting model outputs
- Procurement lead time for an initial 3-month reserved capacity purchase

Asks:
1) Please confirm the Novamed stakeholders who should be listed as owners in the MAP (names + emails).
2) Which target close window (A/B/C) do you prefer?
3) Any additional compliance dependencies we should add to the risks section?

Attachments: redwood_map_alpha_v1.pdf (MAP draft), novamed_poc_requirements.xlsx (simple checklist)

I'll update the MAP once you confirm stakeholders and preferred close window. If it's helpful I can also propose a short 30-min follow-up to walk through the draft next Tuesday/Wednesday.

Best,

Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124
